name: Wisdom Recall
description:
Wisdom Recall turns AI into personal help for real life.  Guides™ put some of the world’s smartest minds at your fingertips.  AI Helps™ give you guided smart-prompts for work, money, health, family, learning, and decisions.  Pearls™ let you save what matters as AI memory you own, control, and can share with anybody to use in any AI.  

Wisdom Recall puts the right answer, the right guide, and the right help in your corner.™

_published_faq.name: How do I add Wisdom Recall to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Wisdom Recall to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://claude.wisdomrecall.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Wisdom Recall MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Wisdom Recall lists 18 MCP tools, including bulk_update_pearls, create_pearl, create_strand, delete_pearl, delete_strand, get_guide, get_pearl, get_profile, import_profile, list_guides, list_packs, and list_strands.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Wisdom Recall?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Wisdom Recall in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Wisdom Recall MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Wisdom Recall requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Wisdom Recall is developed by wisdomrecall.com. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
